module: World Editor cubemap editor (Assets > "Cubemap Editor" menu, "cubemapEditor" window). It lists the CubemapData class objects of the level, lets you create, save and delete a cubemap, assign each of the 6 faces (drag and drop or button), and capture the 6 faces from the camera position (captureCameraCubemap, resolution 128 to 2048 px, power of 2) before assigning them automatically. It also exports the data to a main.materials.json file. Can be opened by another tool via show(onSelectCb) to pick a cubemap.
notes: Captured face files must be named <prefix><0..5>.hdr.dds; if one is missing, the assignment fails with a status error message.
Face order displayed: 0 +X right, 1 -X left, 2 -Y back, 3 +Y front, 4 +Z up, 5 -Z down.
The default base folder is <level path>/art/cubemaps/<datablock name>; it is created if it does not exist.
The capture position is stored in the captureLocation field ("x,y,z"), used by the "Go to cubemap location" button.

show.desc: Opens the cubemap editor window. Loads the cubemap list on the first call, preselects the one whose name is given (otherwise the first if nothing is selected). If a callback is provided, the window shows Select/Cancel buttons; Select calls the callback with the cubemap name and closes the window.

onSelectCb.desc: called with the name (string) of the chosen cubemap

preselectName.desc: name of the cubemap to preselect

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook called at World Editor initialization: registers the window (750x380, hidden) and the "Cubemap Editor" menu entry in the Assets group.

onEditorGui.desc: Hook called every editor frame: draws the window.
